description: This file defines an interface for a wrapper around GLib functions, including methods for object property management, signal handling, memory allocation, and type information. It also includes a factory class for obtaining a singleton instance of the wrapper. The file is part of the Rialto media server component and provides abstraction for GLib operations to facilitate testing or platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: IGlibWrapper
classes.description: Interface providing methods to interact with GLib objects, properties, signals, memory, and types.

classes.name: IGlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for obtaining a singleton instance of IGlibWrapper.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GLib object, with support for multiple property-value pairs.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Retrieves properties from a GLib object, with support for multiple property-value pairs.

methods.name: gObjectClassFindProperty
methods.description: Finds the GParamSpec for a property of a class.

methods.name: gTypeClassRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a GType class.

methods.name: gTypeFromName
methods.description: Gets the GType from a type name.

methods.name: gFlagsGetValueByNick
methods.description: Retrieves the flag value associated with a nickname.

methods.name: gObjectUnref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a GLib object.

methods.name: gSignalConnect
methods.description: Connects a callback to a GStreamer signal.

methods.name: gSignalHandlerDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a signal handler from an object.

methods.name: gTimeoutAdd
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called at regular intervals.

methods.name: gSourceRemove
methods.description: Removes a source identified by its ID.

methods.name: gStrdupPrintf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-like syntax, returning an allocated string.

methods.name: gStrHasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string begins with a specified prefix.

methods.name: gFree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by GLib functions.

methods.name: gSignalListIds
methods.description: Lists signal IDs for a given type.

methods.name: gSignalQuery
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific signal.

methods.name: gObjectType
methods.description: Returns the GType of a given object.

methods.name: gMalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory.

methods.name: gMemdup
methods.description: Duplicates a block of memory.

methods.name: gOnceInitEnter
methods.description: Enters a critical initialization section, ensuring it runs only once.

methods.name: gOnceInitLeave
methods.description: Leaves a critical initialization section, setting its result.

methods.name: gStrrstr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring within a string.

methods.name: gErrorFree
methods.description: Frees a GError object.
